name: Pepper Powdery Mildew
description: A fungal disease causing white powdery growth on pepper leaves, primarily on older leaves. It reduces photosynthesis and can cause premature defoliation, affecting fruit development and yield.
symptoms: White powdery fungal growth on upper leaf surfaces
Yellowing and browning of affected leaf tissue
causes: Dense canopy with poor air circulation
treatments: Apply sulfur-based fungicides at first signs
Spray neem oil solution (5ml/L water) weekly
Use potassium bicarbonate as organic treatment
prevention: Space plants adequately for air circulation
Avoid overhead irrigation — use drip irrigation
Remove lower leaves to improve air flow
